question: What happens to the waned moon at new moon?
premises: here at new moon the waned moon enters breath-sun
it is said in Shri Kamika
inference: the waned moon enters breath-sun and maya proceeds in two parts
plain_english: Here at new moon the waned moon enters the breath-sun; it is said in Shri Kamika, and supreme nature, Maya, proceeds in half-halves in two-part Shiva form.
